description: Implement the 2026-11-10 orchestrator process review: fail-fast dispatch and permissions, a two-round remediation limit with count-free records, committed gate commands with a final-acceptance closeout, and the review's other findings
deviation_notes: (a) The track declares the light lane: it closes on its full gate results (gates.md) without a separate final-acceptance run. (b) bun is not installed on this host, so measure/gates.json runs the dsh suite and the parity scripts for PROJECT_CHECKS instead of the review's `bun x tsc --noEmit`; the tsc gap stays a recorded follow-up (the committed gates do not enforce it yet). (c) The audit-role finding is fixed by narrowing the blanket `*>*` shell deny to `* > *`, `* >*`, and `*>>*` (the permission engine's globs cannot express 'not 2>&1'); a `2>file` write without a space is the remaining residual. (d) The review's defaults were adopted: the orchestrator default shell effect is now deny, the light lane is an approved closeout path, and the two-round limit lives in the shared skill so it applies to DSH too.
